messages:
ana: Hey team — draft for the product launch post is up: https://drive.redwood/infer/launch-draft-v2 (comments enabled). Need quick rounds on: benchmark narrative, gated asset CTA, webinar timing, and inbound routing UTMs. Can we get approvals by EOD tomorrow? :pray:

jamie: on it. I'll do a pass on the narrative + recommended hero metric. planning to call out latency/cost per request vs. open-model baseline.

mike: nice. For the benchmark section we should include a small table and a short note on workload shape (chat vs. streaming). Also include this line: "measured on p4d w/ 64-token average" — can we confirm infra footnote?

devon: webinar date still tentatively Jun 16. If we gate a deeper benchmark deck, we should map CTAs: blog -> gated deck -> webinar/reg form -> nurture sequence. Suggested UTMs: `utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=redwood_launch_deck`.

ana (typo fix): @ana meant to ping — I can wire up a HubSpot form if we finalize fields. Quick Q: do we want a short public deck (no creds) and a gated deep-dive (with raw numbers)?

ana (correction): oops, that was me, sorry.

ana (again): yes to two assets. public highlights + gated deep-dive. gating rationale: capture product-led interest and route to AE SDR playbook.

lisa: legal quick pass: avoid absolute statements like "fastest" unless we qualify. Phrase suggestion: "among the most cost-efficient for X workloads". Also need sources for any performance claims (bench CSV or internal run IDs).

ana: noted. I'll adjust phrasing. attaching the bench snippet here (small sample):

```
Benchmark: chat-100k-requests
Model: rw-infer-3b-quant
HW: p4d.xlarge equivalent
Median latency: 89ms
Cost/token: $0.00045
Notes: mixed short/long prompts, KV cache enabled
```

mike: perfect. Could we also add a short blurb on routing fallback behavior? customers care about reliability — 1-2 lines.

devon: routing blurb ok. Also mapping for inbound: blog UTM -> gated deck form field `source=blog` (hidden) -> HS workflow "launch_deck_registrant" -> assigned to SDR queue `PLG_Inbound_Launch`. I'll send the HS export after form fields are final.

jamie: editorial pass done. Rewrote intro to be less product-sell and more problem/solution. Small ask: can we move the bench charts up so they show measurable impact before the 'how it works' section? converts better.

ana: good call. Moving charts up. Also adding 2 CTAs: 1) Quick trial (no gate) 2) Download deep-dive (gate + form). Want copy for the gated CTA — anyone?

mike: suggestion for gated CTA copy: "Download our deep-dive benchmark deck — detailed runs, configs, and cost breakdowns." Keep it short.

lisa: for gated download, add checkbox: "I agree to be contacted about Redwood Inference" per consent law. Also add privacy link.

publish-bot: Checklist reminder: content review: marketing ✅ | legal pending | product ✅ | infra pending | assets attached? no. Publish date unset.

devon: infra can provide the CSV and run IDs by tomorrow morning. I'll upload to the drive and drop the link.

ana: timeline: editorial finalize today, legal quick-pass tomorrow morning, infra numbers + HS form by noon tomorrow, design to produce hero image by EOD. If all green, target publish Wed next week.

jamie: tiny micro copy request — headline variant A: "Reduce inference cost without trading latency." Variant B: "Predictable LLM inference for production apps." lean towards A.

mike: vote A. more benefit-forward.

lisa: approved on phrasing A with the legal qualification from above.

ana: great. I'll post an updated draft in ~2 hrs with revised hero, moved charts, CTA copy, and the gated form spec. tagging @devon @lisa for the uploads. Thanks all :tada:

devon: FYI — scheduling note: webinar host should be product + infra eng, 30min + 15 Q&A. prefer Tues/Thu evenings for APAC-friendly times.

ana: noted. we'll propose two time windows in the registration form.

publish-bot: Draft saved to /drive/redwood/infer/launch-draft-v3 (versioned). Automated link: https://drive.redwood/infer/launch-draft-v3

mike: LGTM overall. minor nit in the chart caption. I'll annotate in the doc.

jamie: thanks — will do a final sweep once infra uploads the CSV.

lisa: ping me when the final claims are in, I'll sign off quickly.

ana: thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. if anyone wants to volunteer for the webinar script, shout here.

mike: I can help with the demo script.

devon: happy to do infra demo + Qs.

ana: perfect. closing thread for now; will reopen with the v3 doc link.
